question: Kicheri is a harvest festival and involves ritual bathing, celebrated majorly in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kicheri **is a **harvest festival **celebrated majorly in **Uttar Pradesh, India.**
 
• This festival is also known as **Kheer-Chawal Mela**, and it is celebrated during the month of **Kartik (October-November)** as per the Hindu calendar.
 
• The festival involves** ritual bathing** in the holy rivers like **Ganga, Yamuna, and Sarayu.**
 
• People prepare and distribute **Kheer** (a sweet dish made of rice and milk) as **Prasad **among the **devotees and the poor.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In** Madhya Pradesh,** the **harvest festival** is known as **Hareli**, which is celebrated during the month of **Shravana (July-August).**
 
• In **Haryana**, the harvest festival is called **Jitiya,** which is observed during the month of **Bhadrapada (August-September).**
 
• In **Gujarat**, the harvest festival is known as **Navratri, **which is celebrated for nine days during the month of **Ashwin (September-October).**
